scope: A large, clear screen for low vision, a calendar you can edit, attachments by voice, and over 80 fixes.

topics.title: Large text and colors
details: The window now shows the screen name, the list or menu with the chosen item marked, and what was just said.
Text is large and yellow on black at first. Change it in Display options.
Control+Plus and Control+Minus change the text size. Control+9 changes the colors. F11 turns full screen on or off.
You can also say bigger text, smaller text, or high contrast.

topics.title: Calendar and contacts
details: Control+G goes to a date. You can also say go to December 25.
F2 changes an event. You can say move event to Friday at 2.
F2 also changes a contact's name, email, or phone.

topics.title: Attachments by voice
details: Say attach my resume from Documents, or attach the last download.
Say open the PDF, save all to Desktop, or remove photo.

topics.title: Speech transcript
details: Say start transcript to keep a file of everything Voice Companion says. This helps a helper find a problem.

topics.title: Starting up
details: Voice Companion now says one clear message when it starts, every time.
It says the version, any update result, the microphone state, and where you are.
Nothing is cut off, even after an update or with the microphone off.

topics.title: Menus and Options
details: Menus say their full name, such as Document reader menu.
Keys are said the same way everywhere, such as Control+O.
A word Voice Companion did not understand no longer sends you to the main menu.

topics.title: Email, documents, and files
details: A reply to your own sent email now goes to the right people.
A sender name with a comma no longer stops the Inbox from opening.
A file that is damaged or open in another program no longer stops the app.

topics.title: Web, downloads, and media
details: Buttons that change part of a page now say what changed, and keep your place.
Find now finds words on the page, not just links.
A Word file you get from the web now opens in the Document reader.
